name: test-tube
description: A straight test tube with a rounded base and a liquid level.
useCase: A test tube or laboratory sample.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: Straight parallel walls and a perpendicular rim keep the whole tube on one diagonal axis. The rounded base and horizontal liquid level remain clear.

24.reason: The rim is perpendicular to the straight tube, and the rounded base remains tangent to both walls. A horizontal liquid level leaves two open spaces.
